build_adt_video_processor: build an ADTVideoProcessor instance to load and process Aria Digital Twin video sequences
extract_image_data_rgb_depth_segmentatio: extract rgb, depth, and segmentation image data for a chunk of ADT video timestamps
load_adt_data_sequence: load ADT data including timestamps, ground truth provider, and stream id for a sequence path
process_vid_generate_npz: process video chunks from ADT data and generate output npz files with jpeg images and tracking annotations
rotate_encode_jpeg_images: rotate rgb images by -90 degrees and encode them as jpeg bytes for npz output
